result.title: Attention Drift Regularization with Adaptive Initialization for Domain-Robust Visual Recognition
result.summary: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a pretrained source model to unlabeled target domains without source data access, yet two critical failure modes remain unaddressed. First, attention drift: source-learned attention maps shift toward spurious or background features under distribution shift, destabilizing feature representations. Second, domain-gap-agnostic initialization: applying a single fixed source model uniformly across all target domains ignores domain gap severity, causing premature overfitting to noisy pseudo-labels under large shifts. We propose DGA-CAFC to address both failures. The Counterfactual Attention-based Feature Consistency (CAFC) module enforces feature stability by minimizing the discrepancy between representations computed under learned attention and those under counterfactual-inspired normalized perturbations, thereby promoting domain-robust features independent of spurious attention shifts. The Domain-Gap Aware Source Model Selection (DGASS) module estimates domain gap severity via target prediction entropy and selects the source model variant whose confidence level best matches the estimated gap, reducing negative transfer and stabilizing pseudo-label quality. Crucially, CAFC transfers beyond SFDA: applied as a lightweight regularizer to standard domain generalization objectives without target data. Extensive experiments across SFDA and DG benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently improves over recent baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness and generality of the proposed framework. Project page is available at https://visdomlab.github.io/DGA_CAFC

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对无源域自适应中的两个失效模式——分布偏移下注意力图漂向虚假或背景特征、以及对所有目标域统一使用同一源模型初始化——提出 DGA-CAFC：用反事实注意力扰动与学习注意力下表示的一致性约束稳定特征，并按目标预测熵估计域差距以选择源模型变体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「注意力漂移」诊断与反事实注意力扰动下的表示一致性约束，可能为核查注意力结构如何影响 latent 中视觉证据的保留与虚假特征混入提供可借用的扰动式探针思路，但原文面向域自适应图像分类，与 LVR 的推理状态生成无直接关联。
